item.title: The amygdaloid complex: from morphology to neurodegeneration.
item.description:
Worth reading · Brain : a journal of neurology · section: Neurodegeneration · topic is in the title · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Neurodegeneration definition: moderate · published this week
In summary, the amygdala acts as a densely connected hub with a broad role not only in physiological and psychological health but also in disease states; indeed, the amygdala is affected early in several neurodegenerative disorders, and in some (notably limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy and argyrophilic grain disease) it is among the first regions in which pathology is detected.
